name: iteriodev_seats
description: Seats (iDrive 7 + 8): both front seats on one page, seen from the side with hold controls round them (also while driving; Make room parked only), three memories per seat under each, the Gentleman function for the passenger seat and easy exit for both front seats (out of the way when its door opens with someone in the seat, back once the door is shut: driver with the car on, passenger seated; the driver's electric steering column too); seats with motors but no memory keep their hold controls; front end of the iteriodev-comfort tool over its control socket; GPU renderer screens
author: IterioDev

store.description: Move the driver and passenger seats from the central display, also while driving, both on one page: each seat seen from the side with its controls round it (fore / aft, height, backrest, tilt and headrest, while you hold them), three memories per seat under it, the Gentleman button (parked only) that moves the passenger seat out of the way and back, and easy exit for both front seats: save each one's getting-out position and it moves there when its door opens with the car standing and someone in the seat (never with a child seat on it), and back once the door is shut (the driver with the car on, the passenger seated); the driver's electric steering wheel too. Needs the Comfort tool from the same source. Works with the touchscreen or the iDrive controller. iDrive 7 and 8.
